description: "The Cross and the Shamrock" by Hugh Quigley is a historical narrative written in the mid-19th century. This Irish-American Catholic tale explores the struggles and faith of the Irish Catholic diaspora in America, particularly emphasizing the trials and triumphs of the O'Clery family after their emigration.
